{"reason":"Broaden the demand-forecast branch to accept any forecast-bias signal or a market-signal mismatch. V1 leaves 23 cases unknown and recovers only 60.7%; the listed failures include five mismatch cases and three biases below 0.1, so this should raise accuracy and recovered amount while preserving the supplier branch.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
